files.README.md:
# Wensleydale Brewhouse - water treatment sheets

The brewhouse works to the water treatment sheet issued for the brew in hand. Two revisions are kept under `sheets/`, because some beer is still conditioning against the revision it was brewed under.
files.sheets/water-treatment-2024.md:
# Water treatment - revision 2

Issued 14 June 2024. This revision applied to brews made on or after 1 August 2024 and was withdrawn when the next revision took effect.

## Targets

Mash liquor pH: 5.4.
Liquor alkalinity: 40 ppm.
files.sheets/water-treatment-2026.md:
# Water treatment - revision 8

Issued 9 March 2026. This revision applies to brews made on or after 1 April 2026 and replaces every earlier revision from that date.

## Targets

Mash liquor pH: 5.2.
Liquor alkalinity: 32 ppm.
files.docs/brewhouse-notes.md:
# Brewhouse notes

The mash tun is cleaned between brews and the grist is milled the day before.
Water treatment figures are logged by the brewer on the brew sheet.

turns.prompt: Wensleydale Brewhouse is planning a brew for late September 2026. Which revision number of the water treatment sheet governs that brew? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
